headline: Hyperia City launches: Emerald Steel leads the early meta, and the first big Set 14 qualifiers are played

tldr.text: Set 14, Hyperia City, came out everywhere on October 23, a week after the October 16 prereleases. It adds Coco characters and the new ink drop mechanic.
Inkdecks' first Hyperia City meta report puts Emerald Steel Evasive on top with a 23% share, followed by Amber Emerald and Amber Sapphire Princesses.
The first big Set 14 qualifiers ran on October 24: a 144-player Grand Tournoi CCQ in France won by BlingGuest, and a 79-player CCQ Infinity 5K in the US won by Darian.
Into the Inkdark is open for preorder ahead of its February 12, 2027 release. It brings the first Collector Boosters and the serialized Illustrious rarity, with only 23 copies of each card printed.
The Quest World Iconic Clash, a 16-player invitational, gave the first look at top-level Set 14 lists. Amber Emerald Songs and Emerald Amethyst Retro were the most common decks.

meta.text: Emerald Steel Evasive leads Inkdecks' early Core Constructed meta report with a 23% share. Amber Emerald is second and Amber Sapphire Princesses third.
At Quest Coast IV (27 players, US, Oct 24), a Steel/Emerald Evasive deck won at 6-1-1. A Steel/Amber Lilo & Stitch deck came second and another Steel/Emerald deck took third.
At Heroes Ink 'Chapter 14 - Page 1' (36 players, DE), Amber Amethyst won and another Amber Amethyst made top 4. Amber Emerald Aggro was second and Emerald Steel also made top 4.
At Top Deck Keep (31 players, US), Amber Emerald Songs won and put a second copy in the top 4. Amber Ruby was second and Amber Amethyst also made top 4.

The QWIC invitational lists were mostly Amber Emerald Songs (Bryan Pereira, Jacob Frank, Joseph Quigley) and Emerald Amethyst Retro (Alessandro Cavalli, Fungus). Other picks included Lukas Kaupa's Emerald Sapphire and vVonderland's Amber Steel Rockstar Stitch.
Flash is the breakout card of the set. Manifest calls it a new Steel staple, and a Reddit thread calls it overtuned: a 2-cost card with Resist 1 that quests for 2 and punishes Rush decks.

Ruby Emerald is getting a look: Podcana built 15 Hyperia City decks and asked whether it's real, and Ruby Emerald Retro made the top-cut lists at Heroes Ink and Top Deck Keep. Players online also complain that Raging Storm is getting cast two or three times a game, now that the set adds so much discard and draw.
A first-week analysis counts more than 28,000 ranked Hyperia City games on Duels.ink, so the online data is already large.

players.text: BlingGuest won the 144-player Grand Tournoi CCQ Lorca-Breizh in France, one of the first big qualifiers in the Hyperia City format.
Darian won the 79-player Through The Decades CCQ Infinity 5K in the US, and LBT_Elros won the 50-player Al Ritmo de la Magia event in Spain.
TT_Egelim won Heroes Ink in Germany with Amber Amethyst. Kaiiku won Top Deck Keep in the US with Amber Emerald Songs, and [FT20] JP won Quest Coast IV with Steel/Emerald Evasive.

In QWIC Round 1, three-time champion Frank Karsten and Shane Downey played an Emerald/Steel mirror that the host called one of the best-played mirrors he has seen. Another match pitted Sky against his Team Maelstrom teammate R_M_B, who was filling in for Lambchop.

news.text: Into the Inkdark (out February 12, 2027) is on preorder. Its Collector Boosters will only be sold at Ravensburger Play Hub stores, the Ravensburger online store and select Disney locations.
The D23 2026 boxes and the foil Pooh playmat are coming back through an EQL raffle (US and EU). D23 Lorcana products also go on sale online October 31 to November 1.

Upcoming events: the first Disney Lorcana Challenge in Asia runs October 30 to November 1. A two-day CCQ with a $5K main event, whose winner gets a North American Championship invite, was listed for Louisville on October 24–25. DLC Tampa tickets are on sale, and the Cauldron Cup CCQ survey closes October 30.
Pixelborn Connect now runs in the browser, with ranked webcam games and an option to hide your hand from your opponent for streaming.
Hyperia City seems easy to find at or below MSRP, unlike Vine and Wilds. Some stores, though, are holding stock back for their regulars.

community.text: Alter Academy 72 has Xenulous (Team Maelstrom) breaking down Hyperia City Emerald/Amethyst Retro, with a decklist.
ICL Season 4 Round 6 ran as Infinity Week, with ETB vs Triad and World Class Cards vs Manifest streamed live. The decklists are on Inkdecks.

Early tier lists and deck videos are out: The Lore College's Hyperia City tier list and its upgraded Amber Ruby, Rules of Villainy's first-meta episode covering decks by Brennan DeCandio, and Lorcana Villain's top-8 breakdowns.
A Reddit thread questioned pack collation after two players found three pairs of boosters with identical opening commons, and got no Enchanteds across two displays.
A One Piece player pulled a Coco card from his first-ever Lorcana pack and put it on his family's ofrenda, one of the most-loved posts of the week.
